document.title: Session 252 Forward Roadmap — Investigation Platform
document.author: Board J — Operational Intelligence Review
document.purpose: Define the 4-phase forward roadmap from current S252 state to May Admin MVP. Each phase includes sessions, deliverables, dependencies, and success criteria.

criticalFindings: S89B phantom session referenced by all 35 challenges

targetState.goal: May Admin MVP — full browser-based admin portal
readinessCriteria: All 6 engines accessible from unified CLI
HTTP API layer wrapping all engines

phase1.title: Phase 1 — Hardening
phase1.description: Fix critical validation findings, close data gaps, add essential infrastructure before integration begins.

deliverables.name: Deep-Link Critical Fix — P1-E-059
deliverables.description: Resolve the P1-E-059 QID referenced by Session 3 but missing from question_history.json. Either add the QID to question_history or correct session_registry.json's reference.
deliverables.successCriteria: Deep-link check Q→S passes with 0 missing QIDs

deliverables.name: Deep-Link Critical Fix — S89B Phantom Session
deliverables.description: Resolve the S89B session referenced by all 35 challenges and challenge_to_session.json but absent from session_registry.json. If S89B is a real session, add it to the registry. If it's a test artifact, remove all references and rebuild challenge_to_session.json.
deliverables.successCriteria: 0 challenges reference non-existent sessions; S89B either exists in registry or all 35 references resolved

deliverables.name: Session Registry Deduplication
deliverables.description: Deduplicate 63 duplicate session IDs in session_registry.json. Determine whether duplicates are genuine duplicates (same session recorded twice) or different sessions with non-unique IDs. If the latter, assign unique IDs.
deliverables.successCriteria: 0 duplicate session IDs in session_registry.json; deep-link warning count drops from 181 to <100

deliverables.name: Student Data Export Bridge
deliverables.description: Build a mechanism to export student data from browser localStorage to a JSON file consumable by Node.js scripts. Two-part: (a) add export button to the simulator UI that serializes cmaMayLearnerState to a downloadable JSON file, (b) create a synthetic student_roll.json with 5-10 realistic learner profiles for development/testing.
deliverables.successCriteria: Student Exposure Index spec (Board B) can be tested with real or synthetic student data. CLI: node scripts/student_exposure_index.js --student=learner-001 works.

deliverables.name: Implement Student Exposure Engine
deliverables.description: Build scripts/student_exposure_index.js per Board B spec. Must handle: single-student mode (from student_roll or export file), summary-all mode, all 7 output sections (profile, exposure matrix, topic performance, challenge history, recommendation impact, exposure gaps, risk signals), all 15 risk signal computations.
deliverables.successCriteria: Engine generates valid student_exposure.json for at least 1 student; all 7 sections populated; risk signals computed with correct thresholds

deliverables.name: Implement Investigation Registry Engine
deliverables.description: Build scripts/investigation_registry.js per Board D spec. Must handle: --create, --auto-create (from OPEN challenges), --from-challenge, --from-defect, --list (with filters), --get, --update, --close, --summary, --stats. Enforce lifecycle state machine transitions.
deliverables.successCriteria: All 10 CLI operations functional. State machine rejects invalid transitions. Seed data: 12 investigations created from current OPEN challenges.

deliverables.name: Add Incremental Refresh to Health Engine
deliverables.description: Modify scripts/question_health_engine.js to support --qid-only mode (score a single QID without full pool rebuild) and --since=<timestamp> mode (re-score only QIDs whose question_history entries changed).
deliverables.successCriteria: --qid=P1-A-001 runs in <5s (vs. ~30s full pool). --since=2026-07-27 correctly identifies changed QIDs.

successCriteria.studentDataBridge: Operational — at least 1 synthetic student profile importable
successCriteria.newEngines: Student Exposure + Investigation Registry both operational

phase2.title: Phase 2 — Integration
phase2.description: Wire all engines together, create unified CLI, add caching and watchers so the platform operates as a system, not 6 independent scripts.

deliverables.name: Unified CLI — may-admin-cli.js
deliverables.description: Create scripts/may-admin-cli.js as the single entry point for all investigation and admin commands. Subcommands: investigate <qid> (Board A), exposure <studentId> (Board B), triage (Board C), registry <cmd> (Board D), health <qid|section|all> (Board E), intelligence <sessionId|summary> (Board F), validate (Board G).
deliverables.successCriteria: All 7 subcommands functional. help text comprehensive. --json flag outputs raw JSON; default outputs formatted summary.

deliverables.name: Cross-Engine Caching Layer
deliverables.description: Build a shared cache module (scripts/lib/cache_manager.js) that loads question_history.json, session_registry.json, challenge_registry.json, and pack file data once per session. Each engine reads from cache instead of re-parsing files. TTL-based invalidation: cache expires if source file mtime changes.
deliverables.successCriteria: Full investigation pipeline (Board A dossiser → Board E health → Board F session trace for same QID) runs in <60% of current combined time.

deliverables.name: Bidirectional Consistency Checks
deliverables.description: Extend Board G's deep-link validator to perform bidirectional consistency checks: for every QID in session_registry, verify it exists in question_history AND for every sessionId in question_history sessions, verify it exists in session_registry. Close the orphan gap identified in S252 (21 orphan session QIDs + 5 orphan challenge sessions).
deliverables.successCriteria: Bidirectional check passes: 0 one-way orphans in either direction. Deep-link overall verdict: PASS.

deliverables.name: Real-Time File Watchers
deliverables.description: Build scripts/lib/file_watcher.js using Node.js fs.watch. When any pack file (*_corrected.js) changes: (a) trigger backup protocol automatically, (b) invalidate cache for that pack, (c) regenerate question_history.json, (d) push notification to any active investigation workbench.
deliverables.successCriteria: Edit a pack file manually → within 5 seconds, cache invalidates and admin CLI reflects updated data without manual --refresh.

deliverables.name: Registry Regeneration Pipeline
deliverables.description: Build scripts/regenerate_all.js that runs all registry builders in dependency order: question_history → readiness_scoring → work_queue → certification_waves → certification_candidates → question_health → session_intelligence → challenge_triage. Accepts --since=<timestamp> for incremental.
deliverables.successCriteria: node scripts/regenerate_all.js completes in < 2 minutes for full pool, < 30 seconds for --since incremental. All downstream outputs consistent.

deliverables.name: HTTP API Wrapper — Phase 1
deliverables.description: Build a minimal Express.js server (scripts/admin_api_server.js) wrapping the 6 engines as REST endpoints. Phase 1 scope: GET /api/admin/v1/questions/:qid/dossier (Board A), GET /api/admin/v1/health/questions/:qid (Board E), GET /api/admin/v1/sessions/:sessionId (Board F), GET /api/admin/v1/challenges/triage (Board C). No auth yet — localhost only.
deliverables.successCriteria: curl http://localhost:3000/api/admin/v1/questions/P1-A-001/dossier returns full 9-section dossier JSON. All 4 endpoints functional.

successCriteria.caching: Cross-engine cache reduces pipeline time by >=40%
successCriteria.watchers: File watcher detects pack file changes and invalidates cache

phase3.title: Phase 3 — UI Foundation
phase3.description: Build the browser-based investigation dashboard. Implement the workbench state machine in JavaScript. Connect UI to API endpoints. Add role-based access control.

deliverables.name: Investigation Dashboard HTML/CSS Prototype
deliverables.description: Build admin/dashboard.html with CSS (admin/dashboard.css). Implement the 3-column layout from Board I's workbench model: left (challenge triage kanban), center (investigation detail panel + question forensic timeline), right (linked entities graph + finding log). Static prototype — hardcoded sample data.
deliverables.successCriteria: Dashboard renders correctly in Chrome/Firefox/Edge at 1920x1080 and 1366x768. All Board I UI components (kanban, detail-panel, timeline, graph, cluster-chart) have visual placeholders.

deliverables.name: Workbench State Machine — JavaScript Implementation
deliverables.description: Build admin/js/workbench_state_machine.js implementing Board I's complete 10-state lifecycle. Must enforce: valid transitions only, precondition checks before each action, SLA tracking with timers, event logging for audit trail. Use a finite state machine library or pure state pattern.
deliverables.successCriteria: All 42 actions from Board I spec implemented. Invalid transitions throw. SLA timers fire on schedule. Internal state always consistent. Unit test suite with 20+ tests covering all states and edge cases.

deliverables.name: API Client Layer
deliverables.description: Build admin/js/api_client.js that wraps all Phase 2 HTTP API endpoints with fetch() calls, error handling, loading states, and retry logic. Support both real API (when server running) and mock mode (for standalone UI development).
deliverables.successCriteria: All API calls return typed responses. Mock mode returns Board A/B/C/E/F spec-compliant data. Error states handled gracefully with user-visible messages.

deliverables.name: Dashboard Live Data Connection
deliverables.description: Wire the dashboard prototype (D3.1) to the API client (D3.3) and state machine (D3.2). Replace hardcoded sample data with live API calls. Implement: challenge queue loading, investigation detail rendering, dossier display, health score visualization, session trace timeline.
deliverables.successCriteria: Opening dashboard.html loads real challenge queue from API. Clicking a challenge loads full investigation detail. Dossier button fetches Board A output and renders all 9 sections. Health score displays with color-coded tier.

deliverables.name: Role-Based Access Control — Client Side
deliverables.description: Implement client-side RBAC per Board H spec. Build admin/js/auth.js with role definitions (ROLE_SUPPORT through ROLE_SYSADMIN), permission checks (canCreate, canUpdate, canExecuteRemediation, canCertify), and UI gating (hide/disable actions based on role). Local admin API key authentication with 4-hour session.
deliverables.successCriteria: Login with ROLE_SUPPORT key → View 1 visible, all others hidden. Login with ROLE_INVESTIGATOR → Views 1+2, can create investigations, cannot execute remediation. Login with ROLE_SYSADMIN → all 5 views, all actions enabled. Session expires after 4 hours.

deliverables.name: Content Admin View Prototype
deliverables.description: Build View 3 (Content Admin) pages per Board H spec: question inventory table (sortable, filterable, paginated), certification progress dashboard (per-domain progress bars), defect heatmap, remediation batch creation form, certification wave planner wizard.
deliverables.successCriteria: Question inventory shows all 2,540 items. Filtering by section/pack/state/health works. Defect heatmap renders with correct counts. Batch creation enforces Rule 5 (max 30 QIDs).

dependencies.requiresHTTPApi: D2.6 must be complete for D3.3-D3.6

successCriteria.dashboard: Investigation dashboard renders live data from API
successCriteria.stateMachine: Workbench enforces all Board I transitions and SLAs
successCriteria.auth: RBAC gates all views and actions correctly
successCriteria.contentAdmin: View 3 (Content Admin) functional with inventory, health, and batch management

phase4.title: Phase 4 — May Admin MVP
phase4.description: Complete the full May Administration Portal with all 5 views, student exposure analytics, challenge management workflow, governance compliance dashboard, and release management tools.

deliverables.name: View 1 — Student View
deliverables.description: Complete Student View per Board H §View1: student search, student detail dashboard (profile card, session timeline, topic performance heatmap, question exposure table, domain radar chart, challenge list). Connect to Student Exposure Engine (Board B) for live data.
deliverables.successCriteria: All 7 Board H API endpoints functional. Student search works. Session timeline loads real data. Topic performance heatmap renders. Question exposure table filterable by domain/outcome.

deliverables.name: View 2 — Investigator View (Complete)
deliverables.description: Extend Phase 3 investigation dashboard to full Board H §View2 spec: complete challenge triage kanban with drag-and-drop status changes, investigation detail with findings log, question forensic timeline, linked entities graph (force-directed or hierarchical), defect cluster view, finding log with filtering.
deliverables.successCriteria: All 8 View 2 API endpoints functional. Kanban supports drag-and-drop. Entity graph shows QID ↔ challenges ↔ investigations ↔ defects ↔ recommendations. Defect cluster view groups by DL-XXX. Finding log supports filtering by author.

deliverables.name: View 3 — Content Admin View (Complete)
deliverables.description: Complete Content Admin View: finish certification wave planner wizard (multi-step: select candidates → validate → preview → execute), difficulty distribution chart (actual vs CAQS §6.1 targets), question diff viewer (before/after comparison for content changes), section health drill-down panels.
deliverables.successCriteria: Certification wave wizard executes waves with governance guard pre-check. Difficulty chart shows DL-031 inflated items. Diff viewer shows field-level before/after. All 11 Board H View 3 endpoints functional.

deliverables.name: View 4 — Governance View
deliverables.description: Build Governance View per Board H §View4: governance event feed (chronological, filterable by type), compliance dashboard (per-rule pass/fail counts, guard test results), learner-pool safety monitor (Certified items with open defects, blocked items in pool), certification integrity checker (before/after state verification), baseline file integrity panel (13 runtime hashes vs CURRENT_BASELINES.md), risk register (live DEFECT_LIBRARY.md entries with status badges).
deliverables.successCriteria: All 10 View 4 API endpoints functional. Governance feed shows all events. Learner-pool safety monitor flags Certified items with DL-008/DL-026/DL-030. Baseline integrity panel shows green/red per runtime file. Risk register renders each DL entry with current status.

deliverables.name: View 5 — System Admin View
deliverables.description: Build System Admin View per Board H §View5: data integrity panel (file state monitor, pack file parse validation, registry consistency checker), pipeline refresh management (trigger regeneration, view refresh history, force rebuild), audit log (all role mutations with actor + timestamp), system health dashboard (CPU, memory, file I/O metrics for the investigation platform).
deliverables.successCriteria: All 6 View 5 API endpoints functional. Data integrity panel shows live file state. Pipeline refresh triggerable from UI. Audit log captures all authenticated actions.

deliverables.name: Challenge Management Workflow
deliverables.description: Build end-to-end challenge lifecycle flow: student submits challenge → appears in triage kanban → triaged → investigation created → findings → remediation planned → executed → verified → resolved → closed. Each state transition sends notification to assigned investigator. Implement the complete 10-state workbench path per Board I.
deliverables.successCriteria: End-to-end walkthrough: create synthetic challenge, triage, assign, investigate, add finding, plan remediation, execute (with governance guard), verify, resolve, close. All states enforced. Audit trail complete.

deliverables.name: Release Management Tools
deliverables.description: Build release management tools: release candidate validator (runs full validator suite + governance guard + explanation validator), pre-release checklist (per CAQS §14 Gold Standard), changelog generator (from REVISION_HISTORY.md), release notes publisher, rollback manager (restore from .bak files with confirmation).
deliverables.successCriteria: Release candidate validator produces pass/fail report. Pre-release checklist gates with 0 errors required. Changelog generated from revision history. Rollback restores from timestamped backup with confirmation.

deliverables.name: Governance Compliance Dashboard
deliverables.description: Complete the governance compliance view: CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification tracker (per-question verification status), certification pipeline health (waves planned/executed/verified), governance guard rule compliance (per-rule violation counts over time), AGENTS.md protocol adherence monitor (backup protocol compliance, batch cap violations, session closeout completeness).
deliverables.successCriteria: All governance compliance metrics visible. CAQS verification tracker shows per-domain progress. Guard rule compliance shows zero violations. Protocol adherence monitor flags any session that skipped backup or breached batch cap.

successCriteria.releaseTools: Release candidate validation, changelog, and rollback all functional
successCriteria.governanceCompliance: All governance rules monitored in real-time
successCriteria.authentication: RBAC enforced across all views and API endpoints
successCriteria.learnerPoolSafety: Zero Certified items with open DL-008, DL-026, or DL-030 in delivery pool
successCriteria.validationPass: Full validator suite: 0 errors, acceptable warnings per baseline

criticalPath: D1.4 (student data bridge) → D1.5 (student exposure engine) → D2.1 (unified CLI)
D2.1 (unified CLI) → D2.6 (HTTP API) → D3.3 (API client)
D3.1 (dashboard) → D3.4 (live data) → D4.2 (investigator view complete)

riskRegister.risk: Student data remains inaccessible in localStorage
riskRegister.mitigation: D1.4 (export bridge) + synthetic student_roll.json. If bridge fails, Phase 4 student analytics must operate on synthetic data only.

riskRegister.risk: S89B phantom session has no discoverable origin
riskRegister.mitigation: D1.2: if S89B cannot be found, purge all 35 challenge references and rebuild challenge_to_session.json. Accept data loss of challenge-session linkage.

riskRegister.risk: 63 duplicate session IDs indicate systemic registry corruption
riskRegister.mitigation: D1.3: manual investigation of each duplicate. If widespread, session_registry.json may need reconstruction from question_history source data.

riskRegister.risk: No real student challenge volume — triage engine accuracy unknown
riskRegister.mitigation: Accept synthetic seed data as development baseline. Triage engine accuracy on real data is deferred to post-MVP monitoring. Document as known limitation.

riskRegister.risk: Pack file concurrent-write risk (DL-019) not yet resolved
riskRegister.mitigation: Phase 2 file watchers (D2.4) provide file-lock awareness. Phase 4 content admin view (D4.3) enforces write-through with backup protocol. Full solution: .lock file protocol deferred to post-Phase 4.

riskRegister.risk: Node.js HTTP server not designed for production deployment
riskRegister.mitigation: Phase 2 HTTP API (D2.6) is for local development only. Production deployment requirements (HTTPS, rate limiting, CORS, load balancing) are out of scope for May MVP. Document as local-only tool.

riskRegister.risk: Recommendation registry has only 4 entries — insufficient for Board C triage
riskRegister.mitigation: Board C operates without recommendation matching at GATE_3 (falls through to keyword matching). Accept reduced triage accuracy until recommendation registry is populated by certification waves.

totalEstimatedSessions.total: 20-24 sessions from current S252 to May Admin MVP
